payload.summary: Newly traversable Drive assets add Digital Retina measurement chronology and failure oracles, LCME long-horizon contradiction/retention tests, and physical LoRA checkpoint provenance. Retina historical numbers must remain protocol-bound: May-20 82.4% phrase-coverage at tau=.22, May-26 strict-text 35.3/47.5%, June-9 tuned-hard 87.1% and independent Freshset 70.0%, with CLIP-lenient highly threshold-sensitive. LCME hybrid architecture receives no duplicate credit but its 7/10 contradiction handling and P@5=.875 after 200 turns become differential tests. Adapter checkpoints receive zero quality credit until dataset/eval lineage is found.
primary_actions: Harness: freeze Retina threshold/match/dataset/version identity and add binding/hallucination/OCR/art-AI adversarial fixtures.
FRANK/Clay: map historical structured visual stages into provenance-bound VisualPercept semantics, never caption truth or authority.
ClayGraph/UnifiedDB: add temporal contradiction invalidation and long-noise memory retention tests using LCME as differential baseline.
Training/model lane: register and hash Drive adapter variants; locate dataset/eval logs before any reuse/quality claim.
